svg.title: The Castles of Burgundy setup
svg.desc: The game board with face-down goods stacks on phases A to E, six numbered depots around the black depot, the bridge with every turn piece on space 1, the bonus tiles, and every score marker on 0. Beside it, the supply of silver coins, workers, and the white die, and face-down hex tile piles sorted by color. Below, two player areas, each with a duchy board, a castle on the center space, 3 goods, 1 silver, workers, 2 dice, three storage spaces, and an overview board.

g.text: Players 3 and 4 set up the same way, with 3 and 4 workers
